record.excerpt: Tested with the crypto pair ETH/USDT in the four hour chart. … Period: beginning of 2017 until today. … He said in his video that you would make more profit with this strategy than holding the coin. … The green Ichimoku lead line must above the red Ichimoku lead line - only the two lead lines are activated. … A green candle must closed above the green lead line. … A red candle must close below the green Ichimoku lead line.
record.performance_claim: you would make more profit with this strategy than holding the coin
record.notes: Ichimoku cloud (lead lines) trend rule on ETH 4h; Ichimoku periods unstated (compiler must assume 9/26/52); claim is beat buy-and-hold.

spec.claim_summary: An ETH/USDT 4h Ichimoku lead-line strategy that holds long while the green lead line is above the red lead line, entering on a green close above the green line and exiting on a red close below the green line.
spec.untestable_reason: The entry and exit both require Ichimoku lead-line (Senkou Span) values, which the schema has no operands for.

claimed.other: you would make more profit with this strategy than holding the coin

assumptions: Mapped 'ETH/USDT' to Binance spot symbol ETHUSDT.
Timeframe read as 4h from 'four hour chart'.
Direction read as long: buying/holding when conditions hold and exiting on close below the line, consistent with comparison to holding the coin.
Green candle interpreted as close greater than open; red candle as close less than open.
Claimed test period 'beginning of 2017 until today' interpreted as 2017-01-01 to posting date 2021-06-02 for claimed window only; test window is not part of the rule.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Ichimoku Senkou Span lead lines (green lead line and red lead line) and positions/crosses relative to them - the schema has no ichimoku operands and another indicator cannot be substituted, so no mechanical entry or exit can be recovered.
